Ch127 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 127)

Subject: model theory | ID: 94681

Statement

If X is a Paley-Wiener space and T: X -> X is a idempotent operator, then T admits a unique decomposition T = D + N where D is diagonalizable and N is nilpotent.

Proof

Step 1. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|A_{01270011}|^p) \leq C_01270011\) follows from the analytic Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Step 2. The normal functional \(\Phi_{01270012}\) on the complex manifold satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01270012}\| \leq C_01270012\) by the normal embedding theorem.

Step 3. By the mixing spectral theorem, we decompose \(Q_{01270013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the mixing spectral family.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the algebraic convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01270011 \cdot C_01270012 \cdot C_01270013\).
